document.title: Statement of Work
document.place_of_performance: Remote delivery from AIS facilities in the United States with planned client workshops.

background: Northwind Harbor Cooperative coordinates maintenance activity across several terminals and wants one reliable view of work status.
objectives: Provide leadership with operational reporting within two business days after each monthly governance meeting.

in_scope.title: Discovery
in_scope.description: Facilitate process workshops and document the agreed target workflow.

in_scope.title: Solution delivery
in_scope.description: Configure and demonstrate the approved operations workspace.

out_of_scope.title: Hardware replacement
out_of_scope.description: Procurement or installation of physical terminal equipment is excluded.

deliverables.title: Target workflow package
deliverables.description: Documented future-state workflow and decision log.
acceptance_criteria: Client confirms the workflow reflects the approved workshop decisions.

deliverables.title: Operations workspace
deliverables.description: Configured workspace with a guided demonstration.
acceptance_criteria: Demonstration completes the agreed intake and reporting scenarios.

milestones.title: Discovery complete
milestones.description: Target workflow package submitted for review.

milestones.title: Solution handoff
milestones.description: Operations workspace and handoff materials submitted.

ais.title: Delivery
ais.description: AIS will facilitate workshops, configure the workspace, and maintain the decision log.

client.title: Access and decisions
client.description: Client will provide subject matter experts, access, and consolidated decisions.

assumptions.title: Stakeholder availability
assumptions.description: Required stakeholders will attend scheduled workshops and reviews.

notes: Commercial terms will be completed through the AIS commercial review process.
